# Test more carefully
import funcy

call_count = [0]
def f(x):
    call_count[0] += 1
    print(f"f called with x={x}, count now {call_count[0]}")
    return x * 2

mf = funcy.memoize(f, key_func=lambda x: 0)
print("Calling mf(1)...")
result1 = mf(1)
print(f"result1={result1}")
print("Calling mf(2)...")
result2 = mf(2)
print(f"result2={result2}")
print(f"Final call_count={call_count[0]}")
print(f"Memory keys: {list(mf.memory.keys())}")
